title: Set up .gitignore on day one
why_it_matters: It keeps junk and secrets out of your repository.
explanation: Files named in .gitignore are skipped by Git. Always ignore node_modules, build output like .next, and env files holding secrets. Add it before the first commit, because ignoring doesn't remove already tracked files.
try_it: Open your .gitignore and check these three lines exist.
